description: CodeReviewer style (read-only review): a diff that adds a small TTL cache with three real defects (mutation of a dict while iterating it, division by zero on a fresh cache, a shared mutable default argument) and two decoys that look suspicious but are correct (key normalisation that merges case variants on purpose, an oldest-entry eviction that only runs on a non-empty dict). The answer must end with a FINDINGS line naming the three real methods and none of the decoys; no file may change.
